cover_letter:
Dear Adecco Belgium Marketing Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing Intern position at Adecco Belgium. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, content creation, and web design, I am eager to bring my skills to your team and contribute to your marketing initiatives.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content writing. I have successfully built and maintained client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme, ensuring they are optimized for search engines and user experience. My work has involved tracking performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, which has given me a solid understanding of data-driven marketing.

One of my proudest projects is mirook.com, a website I designed and built for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project allowed me to apply my technical skills to real-world challenges and see measurable improvements in search health.

I am particularly drawn to this internship because of the opportunity to work on diverse marketing tasks, from content creation to event coordination. I am comfortable with social media management and have experience integrating social platforms into websites. I am also proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and have a creative mindset that I believe will be an asset to your team.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I am currently improving my Dutch (B1). I am fluent in English and Turkish, which I believe will help me adapt content for diverse audiences. I am proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to learn from experienced professionals.

I would be thrilled to contribute to Adecco Belgium's marketing efforts and grow as a marketing professional. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
